notes.title: New map teaser: House
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I come with the greatest happiness to announce the teaser of the new map:

[previewyoutube=s_mOTEK_2W0;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the new map, the game will undergo a HUGE gameplay overhaul:

The new map should come out soon, in addition to other joint fixes.

Thanks for giving our game a try!

Happy 2023!

notes.title: There Won't be Light: new features and release date set to 23th September!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As our Playtest has finished, we gathered a lot of feedback from your tests, and we are implementing all new features and fixing the bugs. First of all, let's jump into the features that will be available with the game's release on Early Access:


 Purge Mode (Cooperative up to 5 players): Beware of the entity in the darkness. In this cooperative mode, you and your friends must complete the ritual while the monster hunts you. But beware of your voice, since whomever that lies in the shadows will hear you.
 Flashlight mode: Our game uses your voice as a light mode. But sometimes, you just want to play the classic way. The flashlight mode changes the session to a flashlight as your light, and the voice just a VoIP feature.


We will also be removing the Possessed mode until further tests make it more stable. Many people enjoyed it, but we are not satisfied with the results yet. When it's in a better state, we will bring it back.

Last, but not least, There Won't be Light is set to be released by 23th September, with the price of $4.99 (or the equivalent regional price set by Steam).

But, even though it's the release, we need your opinion, because your feedback is still crucial! Your feedback allowed us to better tune our game and find bugs to fix them. The game is set to be released in Early Access, and it's your opinion that will allow us to better improve our game!

We hope you enjoy the game, and stay tuned for more info!
